clips.title: The story
paras: Off Auberdine, Gaffer Jack parts lie beneath Darkshore's waves. Wizbang Cranktoggle lost a crate of them during his voyage across the sea.

Gnome tinkerer Wizbang Cranktoggle booked passage to Auberdine, seeking quiet away from Ironforge's forge-works and taverns. During the voyage, he drank too much and fumbled an entire container of gaffer jacks over the railing. The small fasteners sank into Darkshore's coastal waters, leaving Wizbang without the parts he needed to tune his stintle pegs.

The gaffer jacks sank in the surf along Darkshore's shore, where patient fishermen sometimes snag them on their hooks. Recovering the parts lets Wizbang assemble his strange contraptions. Finding tiny metal hardware in the open sea takes patience and luck.
